title: Commands: decide, reject, withdraw
lead: Answer, reject or withdraw an open question.
findings_note: PROJECT.md v1 feature tier; Lifecycle; Milestone 2

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Goal 3: record a decision with a rationale and a link to the question it
answers.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `dlog decide ID OPTION --why TEXT` sets status `decided`, `decision`,
  `rationale`, `decided_at`, and appends history.
- `dlog decide ID --text TEXT --why TEXT` records a free-text decision.
- `dlog reject ID --why` and `dlog withdraw ID --why` set their statuses.
- Deciding a record that is not `open` fails with a non-zero exit.
- `decided_by` is recorded (C18).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Call the model transitions from the commands. Gap: PROJECT.md does not say how
`decided_by` is supplied (flag, config or environment); ask the owner.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
